title: A period that has period-end answers keeps its end when the pay's date is corrected; answers are named by the occurrence that started the period (decision T1, final_review_3 f1b)
story: Set up Fri 20 Nov 2026: the bank holds 400,000, of which 30,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed); a trip place starts empty. Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier) starts the period; Free to spend is 60,000 a month. The pay was ticked as landing Tue 8 Dec, so the period begun by pay@2026-11-10 ended Mon 7 Dec. That morning the person answers its period end: 20,000 of Free to spend to the trip, one record pe:pay@2026-11-10:free dated the period's last day. On Tue 8 Dec they spend 2,000 from Free to spend. Later they correct the ticked pay's date to Wed 9 Dec (it was in the bank a day later). The period already has answers, so its end stays Mon 7 Dec and the new period still began Tue 8 Dec. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the answer for the period begun by pay@2026-11-10, dated its last day
ticked on 8 Dec as landing that day; its date later corrected to 9 Dec

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend for the period that began Tue 8 Dec, the day after the answered period's last day) - 2,000 (spent Tue 8 Dec) = 58,000
asks.note: Before T1 the corrected date moved the period start to Wed 9 Dec and the 2,000 fell in the old period: 60,000.

asks.question: place
asks.why: 0 (opening) + 20,000 (the answer pe:pay@2026-11-10:free, its move to the trip) = 20,000
